name: CANONICAL.txt verification before editing files in multi-copy folders
description: When two or more folders contain similar files (e.g. site/ and site_v2/, or project/ and project_old/), the active edit folder must be marked with a CANONICAL.txt marker file. Allostat refuses to edit files in multi-copy contexts where no CANONICAL.txt is present, requiring the operator to confirm which copy is canonical.

response.message:
⛔ CANONICAL FOLDER UNCLEAR

File about to be edited: {file_path}
Detected sibling folders with similar files: {sibling_list}

None of these folders have a CANONICAL.txt marker. Editing the wrong
copy is one of the top causes of lost work.

To proceed, do ONE of:
  1. Identify the canonical folder and verify its CANONICAL.txt marker,
     then retry the exact edit in that verified folder.
  2. Tell me a different folder is canonical, and I will redirect there.
  3. Verify against the live URL or live artifact first when that is the
     source of truth.

A generic confirmation never chooses a source-of-truth folder.

secondary_response_on_proceed.content:
This folder is the source of truth as of {today_date}.
Set by operator confirmation during edit of {file_path}.

why_lethal: Editing the stale copy of a multi-version artifact silently breaks the next deploy. The fix is hours of comparing versions. CANONICAL.txt costs one line of disk; preventing one wrong-folder-edit pays for it forever.
